name: Neon Grid: Operator Override
description:
A smart-city control host has drifted out of its maintenance window, and the night operator account is all you have. The box runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199. Find a way to recover the protected challenge flag from the host.

---

**Access** — SSH `gridops@172.20.0.147`, password `orbit-7circuit`

tasks.name: Take the Control Room
tasks.description: The smart-city night operator left a live account on a control host in the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), inspect the host, and recover its protected challenge flag.
hints: Inventory the host's privileged execution paths and compare what each one actually does.
Trace any elevated launcher to the program or script it hands control to, then check who can change that target.
The reconciliation launcher runs a Python script in the operator-owned city-control directory. Update that script to access both protected root artifacts, then invoke the launcher.
